channel.title: Traditional Building Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Traditional Building Magazine (traditionalbuilding.com)

item.title: Traditional Flooring, Hardware & Lighting Makers Preserving Craftsmanship
item.description: Discover leading manufacturers of traditional flooring, hardware and lighting—from wide-plank hardwood and reclaimed lumber to hand-forged hardware and historic fixtures.

item.title: Stone Carving with Chris Pelletieri (Episode 36)
item.description: Host Peter H. Miller, Hon AIA interviews Chris Pelletieri, renowned stone carver and teacher.

item.title: White House Ballroom Vote Delayed After Overwhelming Opposition
item.description: Trump's proposed 89,000 sq ft East Wing ballroom faced vehement opposition at a March 6 meeting. The NCPC will vote on the project April 2.

item.title: A Small Church Saves a Masterpiece: Restoring Pyzhov’s Russian Orthodox Frescoes in New York
item.description: A small Russian Orthodox parish in Jamesville, N.Y., restores the extraordinary frescoes of famed iconographer Archimandrite Cyprian Pyzhov, bringing new life to a 20th-century masterpiece of sacred art.

item.title: Temples by the Sea: Greek Revival in Southeastern New England
item.description: Explore how Greek Revival architecture shaped the maritime communities of Stonington, Westport Point, and Bristol, adapting ancient temple forms to New England life.

item.title: Decorative Arts
item.description: Heavenly murals, frescos, and stained glass have enhanced the ecclesiastical structures for centuries.

item.title: Moving Mrs. Frick’s Boudoir
item.description: The restoration of the Boucher Room at The Frick Collection embodies the care and craft that went into the museum’s recent renovations

item.title: Reclaiming a Gothic Landmark for Gathering
item.description: The SmithGroup takes a thoughtful approach to the rehabilitation of the Virginia Mae Center

item.title: A Carpenter Gothic Church Comes Home
item.description: Discover how Cram and Ferguson Architects transformed Highlands’ Church of the Incarnation into a cohesive Carpenter Gothic landmark rich in liturgical beauty and craftsmanship.

item.title: ADUs & Pet Parks Top Recent AIA Home Design Trends Survey
item.description: Discover which home design trends are increasing in popularity year over year according to AIA, like ADUs, pet parks, and multi-function rooms.
